summary: PrimeEnergy Resources Corp filed an 8-K (Items 5.07, 8.01) on June 11, 2026, reporting annual meeting voting results and a board-authorized share repurchase program. The board authorized repurchase of up to 300,000 shares via open-market or privately negotiated transactions, at management's discretion, subject to market conditions and cash availability. No premium, expiration, or material terms were disclosed beyond authorization. The repurchase is a capital-return signal, reducing float and returning cash to shareholders. Watch for actual execution pace and any subsequent tender offers, as the open-market nature limits typical risk-arb precision.
